Detector V33 was trained and measured this run but HELD, not shipped: on the permanent frozen probe it caught 13 of 18 humanized texts, exactly the shipped V20's 13 — the gate needs an improvement, not a tie — so V20 stays live until a round genuinely beats it. The round's marker-balance design (400 real human texts selected for high informal-voice marker density, 41.3 per 1,000 words, labelled human) gained two probe texts and lost two, raised mean probe confidence, held the second probe at 12 of 12, the false-flag rate at 4.34% (below V20's 4.71%), GPT-5 detection at 92.2%, and neural-paraphrase detection at 53.3%.
